**[P2] Preserve earlier invocation boundaries in terminal roots**

`liveTimestamp()` is anchored anew for every invocation, while reset discards the previous boundary. After a backward wall-clock adjustment, a terminal `Workflow` or `DurableExecutionRoot` can therefore end before an already-exported child `Invocation` from the same warm plugin; the new rollback test omits that containment assertion for negative steps. Retain a per-execution high-water end across resets and clamp terminal root ends to it; mirror this in `ExecutionOtelPlugin` and test the same-plugin rollback case.
